description: This file contains platform-specific functions and configurations for the iMX target in OpenWrt, including checks for image compatibility, upgrade procedures, and configuration copying tailored for specific hardware models.

methods.name: enable_image_metadata_check
methods.description: Sets REQUIRE_IMAGE_METADATA=1 for specific board names to enable image metadata verification.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Checks if the current hardware platform supports the given image, performing platform-specific validation.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs the hardware-specific upgrade process depending on the board name.

methods.name: platform_copy_config
methods.description: Copies configuration files to the device, tailored for specific boards.

methods.name: platform_pre_upgrade
methods.description: Pre-upgrade steps, such as preparing the device, specific to certain hardware models.
